en.headline: 390 own commits and 47 issue actions across 14 repositories
en.teaser: Most work went into the daily-summary repo, four OpenCode skill projects and a translation extension, with releases in three of them.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-02 with no missing days. Activity totalled 390 own commits plus 662 automated commits, 0 pull requests, 47 issue actions and 0 reviews. Work concentrated on a personal daily-summary repository, four OpenCode-related skill and tooling projects, a browser translation extension, and issue reporting in third-party OpenCode clients.

### Daily summary pipeline

In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` the main thread was the AI summary of the daily digest. Commits fixed Markdown rendering in release notes, added inline code and bold support to AI summaries, and corrected inline-code background colours for dark mode. A root cause was found for truncated summaries: `max_tokens` counted reasoning tokens, leaving content empty, so reasoning was disabled and deterministic truncation added. Regression tests and a mock AI summary test were added, and a test-render assertion collector bug was fixed.

### OpenCode skill projects

`opencode-skill-management` built the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, plus documentation and release candidates. `opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, atomic snapshot writes, version-badge drift checks and calibration fixes. `opencode-agent-sandbox` mostly archived knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication and Windows path issues. `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across rules, samples and guides and shipped two patch releases.

### Translation and research

`sopen-translate` was initialised and grew an MV3 skeleton with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer, glossary pipeline and DOM smoke tests; selection translation was later dropped. `meld-deepresearch` implemented an improvement plan covering renderer, merge, validator and genre templates, added a SenseNova capability gap analysis, and fixed site layout and footer issues. `myBlog` only added OpenChamber capture screenshots.

### Upstream issue reporting

Most issue actions were filed against `openchamber/openchamber` and `anomalyco/opencode`, covering MCP settings omissions, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel breakdowns, capture resolution, model switching and MiMo vision handling on the Go endpoint. Smaller reports went to `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` and two OpenSenseNova skill repositories.

zh.headline: 14 个仓库共 390 次本人提交与 47 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 主要精力放在每日摘要仓库、四个 OpenCode 技能项目和一个翻译扩展上，其中三个项目发布了版本。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-04 至 2026-11-02，没有缺失数据的日期。整体为 390 次本人提交，另有 662 次自动提交，0 个 PR，47 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），0 次评审。工作集中在个人每日摘要仓库、四个 OpenCode 相关技能与工具项目、一个浏览器翻译扩展，以及向第三方 OpenCode 客户端提交问题反馈。

### 每日摘要流水线

在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，主线是每日摘要的 AI 总结。提交修复了 release notes 的 Markdown 渲染，为 AI 摘要增加内联代码与加粗支持，并修正深色模式下的内联代码底色。截断问题的根因被定位为 `max_tokens` 计入了推理 token 导致正文为空，于是关闭 reasoning 并加入确定性截断。此外补充了回归测试与 AI 摘要 mock 测试，修复了 test-render 断言收集器的缺陷。

### OpenCode 技能项目

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，并完成规范文档与候选版本。`opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、原子快照写入、版本徽章漂移检查与校准修复。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 以归档知识为主，记录 OpenCode V2 分发、认证与 Windows 路径问题。`asset-inventory` 修正了规则、示例与指南中的技能调用说明，并发布两个补丁版本。

### 翻译与研究

`sopen-translate` 从初始化起步，搭建 MV3 骨架，实现双语页面渲染、分块、熔断、进度、provider 协议层与术语表流水线，并补充 DOM 冒烟测试，随后移除了划词翻译。`meld-deepresearch` 落地改进计划（渲染器、合并、校验器、类型模板），加入 SenseNova 能力差距分析，并修复站点卡片居中与页脚问题。`myBlog` 仅新增 OpenChamber 截图。

### 上游问题反馈

issue 互动主要发生在 `openchamber/openchamber` 与 `anomalyco/opencode`，涉及 MCP 设置遗漏、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比、截图分辨率、模型切换与 Go 端点的 MiMo 视觉问题。另有少量反馈提交给 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` 以及两个 OpenSenseNova 技能仓库。

报告 Go 端点对 MiMo 模型拒绝图片输入，该 issue 随后被关闭。
提出让 harness 可扩展并以 MCP 形式对外暴露的功能请求。
